name: Hibira
subtitle: Your realtime apps, anywhere
description:
Hibira in your pocket. Check on your realtime apps, answer approval requests and keep an eye on your waiting rooms and live chat, all from one app.

• Overview: every app's connections, messages and usage against your plan.
• Debug console: watch your app's events as they happen.
• Approvals: approve or reject requests from your workflows and AI agents, add a comment, and see who decided what.
• Waiting rooms: see who is queued and let people in.
• Live Chat: open your team's inbox and reply to website visitors.
• Notifications: approval requests, usage alerts, service status, payment and webhook problems arrive as push notifications. Tap one to open the page it is about.
• Seven languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.

Hibira needs a Hibira account. Sign up free at hibira.io.
promotionalText: Approve requests, watch your apps' events and get usage alerts on your phone.
